family_separation.do_not_infer_from: unrelated B2 diagnostics or H1 carrier-family experiments
family_separation.frozen_582073_family: C2-CAL-1 B2 sealed H-C arrays, deployed M3, copied unchanged into RIFT
family_separation.paper_formula_family: population-conditioned q16/lambda100/shrinkage description; artifact-level equality to the C2-CAL-1 B2 arrays is not established

materializer.exact_operation: activity_signature: pre_pool Linear(1024,32)+ReLU per trial then mean across M3; concatenate [32 activity, 4 precomputed H-C]; post_pool Linear(36,32)+ReLU -> Linear(32,32)+ReLU -> Linear(32,700).
materializer.input: sealed C2 M3 payload row identity [3,1024,176] plus precomputed carrier [176,4]
materializer.non_claim: this code consumes H-C but contains no target H-C PCA, regression, shrinkage, or normalizer construction

paper_binding.reason: the sealed C2/RIFT chain establishes exact final arrays and their materializer, but neither the RIFT payload, copied B2 payload receipt, C2 M3 payload receipt, nor the materializer contains a solver provenance record tying those arrays to q=16, lambda=100, PCA/whitening, U, shrinkage, or a source normalizer. The paper formula may describe another H1 carrier family; it cannot be asserted as the frozen submission method from the audited artifacts.

payload_derivation.statement: loads BT_PAYLOAD h1_c2_cal1_b2_s42_ema_e18_L200.pkl, assigns banks = bt[bank_by_dataset_tag], then serializes the same banks into the RIFT payload; no H-C estimator is called

required_to_close_formula_binding: a sealed C2 carrier-construction receipt or source snapshot whose input array hashes and output H-C hashes match all 27 payload tags
the exact values/provenance of source mean/scale, PCA P, U, shrinkage hyperparameters, and normalizer, or an explicit declaration that the paper must not attribute them to 582073
scope: read-only binding audit for frozen H1 RIFT submission 582073; no score, GPU, model, or paper mutation
